text:
Sympathetic innervation to the colon, the viscus involved in this irritable bowel presentation, originates from preganglionic neurons in the thoracolumbar intermediolateral cell column, **T7–L2** (in practice mostly T10–L2 for the colon). Those fibers travel via the thoracic and lumbar splanchnic nerves to the superior and inferior mesenteric ganglia. L3–L5 is the wrong choice because those segments supply the lower limbs and somatic structures, not the colon.

CONFIDENCE: 70
